free.title: SUNSET CIRCUS AT BRYANT PARK
free.caption:
FREE · BRYANT PARK

A full circus is taking over Bryant Park for one hour - and it costs nothing.

Parallel Exit's Sunset Circus lands on the Bryant Park lawn this Saturday at 5 PM as part of the free Picnic Performances series: aerialists, jugglers and acrobats working against the Midtown skyline while the sun drops behind the towers. No tent, no tickets, no catch - one of the best free things to do in NYC this weekend.

TIP: lawn space goes fast - roll out a blanket by 4:30 and you are front row.

Tag the friend who still talks about running away with the circus.

food.title: WEEKEND 5: AUG 29-30
food.caption:
WEEKEND 5 · AUG 29-30

The last weekend of August in NYC is stacked - here are five moves, most of them free.

Brooklyn Brewery throws one final party at its 30-year Williamsburg home before the big move. The Freedom Party brings its throwback dance floor to Brooklyn Bridge Park. Two flea markets - DUMBO's Archway and Chelsea's 8 AM dealer rows - cover the vintage hunt, and Smorgasburg closes it all out Sunday in Prospect Park.

TIP: swipe for exact times, addresses and trains on every card.

Send this to the group chat that never makes a plan.

art.title: COLOR FACTORY X WICKED
art.caption:
ART · SOHO

The confetti room at Color Factory just went full WICKED - pink and green, for a limited time.

SoHo's most photogenic museum runs 14 rooms of immersive color art at 251 Spring St, from a giant ball pit to built-in cameras that shoot free digital photos, with sweet treats handed out along the way. The Broadway collab makes right now the moment to go, first visit or rerun.

TIP: book the earliest timed slot - empty rooms, clean shots.

Share this with whoever color-coordinates their outfits.
